text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's finally the day of Curren Chan's debut. She should be nervous, but she seems completely fine, uploading selfies to social media.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But with seemingly more than enough motivation for the race, Curren Chan takes her first step toward mastering cuteness!
